modules.name: Research-preserving controller
modules.summary: Only unchanged reads count toward the learned limit; navigation and actions stay available. A requested artifact must be created before finish.

modules.name: Live control recovery and text replacement
modules.summary: Replaced, hidden and disabled controls return a fresh observation without blind retries. Supported fields replace existing text before insertion.

modules.name: 45 generated release checks
modules.summary: Fifteen families across three seeds: 28/45 before correction and 45/45 afterward. Controlled host fixtures, separate from model task quality.

modules.name: Varied actual local-model tasks
modules.summary: gpt-oss:20b builds a calculator and researches two catalog pages. Independent inputs and observed fixture data verify its actual saved outputs.

modules.name: Eight-case promotion gate v2
modules.summary: The automatic candidate suite retains eight actual cases, now with research-preserving read semantics. Broader release checks do not become the promotion gate.

modules.name: Versioned evidence and contract
modules.summary: Java checkpoints bounded episodes and candidates with runtime contract identity, validates evaluation digests, and restores policy and prototypes together.

modules.name: Preserved visual workspace
modules.summary: Library/browser left, canvas/source center, agent right, timeline below. No new stub pages or replacement design.

modules.name: Preserved full Game Lab
modules.summary: Original native Studio remains separate. The successor retains complete game sources and its separately launched editor.

modules.name: Withheld tasks and embodied learning
modules.summary: More withheld families, navigation races, tick/entity-aligned episodes and small-model target evaluation come before broad self-training claims.
